div.div: 5 تحدّس الأَخْبَارَ , (S, K,) and عَنِ الأَخْبَارِ, (AZ, S, A, K,) He sought to learn the news, or tidings, without others' knowing of him; (AZ, S, M, A, K;) as also تندّس عنها, and توّجس: (AZ, TA:) or he sought for, or inquired respecting, the news, or tidings, in order to know what others knew not. (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
